title: FurtherAI Launches Fully EU-Hosted Instance for European Insurance
summary: FurtherAI is now available on a fully EU-hosted instance for European carriers, MGAs, and brokers — with EU data residency across models and infrastructure.
body_markdown:
Today we're launching a **fully EU-hosted instance of FurtherAI** , with data routed exclusively within the European Union. European insurance organizations can now deploy FurtherAI across their workflows on infrastructure that meets the data residency standards the region requires.


The new instance is live at[eu.app.furtherai.com](https://eu.app.furtherai.com/) .


## **Data residency, engineered into the deployment**


For European carriers, MGAs, and brokers, data residency is a hard compliance requirement. GDPR and internal governance policies point to the same thing: customer data and operational data need to stay within the region.


The EU-hosted instance of FurtherAI runs entirely on EU-based infrastructure, and data routes exclusively within the EU throughout the workflow. Every workflow and document processed inside the instance stays within European borders end-to-end.


That extends to the AI models themselves. The instance supports GPT and Claude models with EU data residency.


## **The infrastructure catches up with our European presence**


FurtherAI has been building presence across the European insurance market for a while now, growing the team in the region and working more closely with the carriers, MGAs, and brokers operating there. The EU-hosted instance is the infrastructure layer completing that presence.


The pattern here is the same one we've followed everywhere else: get close to the operators doing the work and build what they need to actually run FurtherAI in production. In Europe, that meant regional hosting with regional data routing.


## **Deploy FurtherAI on EU-hosted infrastructure today**


If you're a European carrier, MGA, or broker who wants to deploy FurtherAI without moving data outside the region, the new instance is ready. Visit[eu.app.furtherai.com](https://eu.app.furtherai.com/) or[get in touch](https://www.furtherai.com/book-demo) to talk about what deployment looks like inside your operation.


Our European expansion continues.
